name: Repository list
responsibility: Names each vault the way the navigator lists it: a repository identity, or an untracked vault's registry name, read from the chosen checkout
description: A vault whose real path is not <dir>/.archboard/vault, such as one that a link leads out of the layout, is no vault here: its checkout reads no-vault, and an untracked one is not listed. A vault that no registry entry holds has no repository name. Every vault has a checkout, the directory that holds it, so a pane and a shown board always report one. No environment variable names a vault: the page opens in the first ready repository by name.
